plan.rule2: Round 2, added after round 1's confirmation (seeds 15-19) left two cells below AdaDiag-DL (GAIA F1 -0.009, Hotel HR@1 -0.008). The selection criterion changes from the mean score to balance, because the goal is to improve every dataset. One new candidate is screened on the development seeds 0-2: bag+rootd (the root readout with its softmax detached, so the FTI loss cannot reshape the RCL ranking). Eligible: every variant with bag screened on the development seeds (bag, bag+attn, bag+selfres, bag+ema, bag+root, bag+neigh, bag+root+neigh, bag+rootd). For each, the six development-seed differences against AdaDiag-DL (HR@1 and F1 x 3 datasets) are computed; among those with a score of at least +0.005, the winner is the one whose smallest difference is largest. It is confirmed on fresh seeds 20-24, never used before, against AdaDiag-DL and TVDiag as released, with round 1's final change alongside.
plan.rule3: Round 3, the last, added after both rounds' changes were run on seeds 5-9: there AdaDiag-DL with Eq. 13's learnable theta (section 6.19) scores as high as round 1's change, and higher than AdaDiag-DL on all six cells, while theta acts on the loss weights rather than the features. Screened on the development seeds 0-2: theta alone, bag+theta, bag+root+theta and bag+neigh+theta. Eligible: these four and every variant eligible in round 2. Selection as round 2: among variants with a score of at least +0.005 against AdaDiag-DL, the one whose smallest of the six differences is largest. Confirmed on fresh seeds 25-29, never used before, against AdaDiag-DL and TVDiag as released. Whatever round 3 yields is reported; there is no round 4.
